## Computing review

### Exercise 7

```{r}
ikea <- read_csv("data/ikea.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: ex-07

ggplot(data = ikea, aes(x = price_usd)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(x = "price in usd",
       y = "number", 
       title = "The distribution of price in usd")

```
